response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film), above_baseline AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_length FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE r.avg_length > b.avg_length), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM above_baseline) SELECT AVG(a.avg_length) AS mean_length, AVG(a.avg_length - b.avg_length) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(a.avg_length - k.avg_length) AS mean_above_kept_mean FROM above_baseline a CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean k WHERE a.avg_length > k.avg_length
